# ModelDummyAntiAliasing

**Enum** · namespace `VRFramework.Core.Runtime` · assembly `VRFramework.Core.Runtime` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Runtime/Scripts/Camera/ModelDummyCreator.cs#L14)

How many samples the edges of a model dummy are rendered with. More samples means smoother
silhouettes and more video memory while the picture is being taken.

```csharp
public enum ModelDummyAntiAliasing
```

## Fields

### None {#none}

`None = 1`

One sample. Edges come out stepped.

### X2 {#x2}

`X2 = 2`

Two samples.

### X4 {#x4}

`X4 = 4`

Four samples. Enough for a product shot at any sensible resolution.

### X8 {#x8}

`X8 = 8`

Eight samples. Costs eight times the video memory of the plain render.
